modules.title: 页面说保存成功，怎样确认数据真的写进去了？
这个案例怎样从失败变成可验收结果

items.title: 问题与关键机制
items.text: 页面提前显示保存成功不能证明数据库已完成写入；在检查输入与权限后，执行目标记录写入并等待提交完成，再把实际结果返回页面。

items.title: 怎样观察改善
items.text: 写入完成后再返回成功，失败时返回具体原因，不能用提前更新的本地状态冒充成功。刷新页面后，用同一个标识查询并显示刚才保存的昵称。

items.title: 发布成绩也要确认写入
items.text: 老师发布成绩后，要确认成绩记录已写入并提交；重新打开学生成绩页仍能读到新分数，才证明写入完成。

modules.title: 仍不保证什么
modules.text: 写入数据库不等于备份、复制到所有节点或所有读取立刻可见；这些是另外的可靠性与数据分发问题。

lessonPractice.title: 接口返回 200，但刷新后昵称仍是旧值。先用什么证据排查？

options.label: 核对写入是否完成并提交，再查刷新请求读取的是否是同一条记录
options.feedback: 对。数据库记录能证明是否写入，刷新查询目标能证明页面是否读回了同一条数据。

options.label: 只把保存按钮后的本地昵称改成新值，让页面先看起来正确
options.feedback: 这只能改变当前页面，刷新后仍要依赖真实写入，无法证明数据库有新值。

options.label: 把成功响应延迟几秒，再刷新观察旧值是否偶尔消失
options.feedback: 延迟不能证明写入是否完成，也不能找出查询错记录、未提交或写入失败的原因。

en.title: The API returns 200, but refreshing the page still shows the old nickname. What evidence should you check first?

options.label: Verify the write and commit completed, then check whether refresh reads the same record
options.feedback: Correct. The database record proves whether the write happened, and the refresh target proves the page requested that same data.

options.label: Only update the local nickname after clicking save so the page looks correct first
options.feedback: That changes only the current page; refresh still depends on a real write and proves nothing about the database.

options.label: Delay the success response for a few seconds and see whether refresh sometimes changes
options.feedback: A delay proves neither that writing finished nor whether the read used the wrong record or an uncommitted value.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 页面收到 200 但刷新后昵称恢复旧值。请沿着请求检查权限校验、数据库写入、提交完成和返回时机，并确认刷新查询的是同一条记录。修好后保存一次、刷新一次，再直接核对数据库记录和接口响应；不要只改本地状态。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The API returns 200 but the old nickname returns after refresh. Trace validation, the database write, commit completion, and response timing, and confirm refresh reads the same record. Fix it, save once, refresh once, and inspect both the database row and API response; do not only change local state.

learning.assumes: You have used a page that saves data and reads it again after refresh.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish a success message from a completed database write and verify both the record and the refresh read.

modules.title: The page says saved. How do you verify the data was really written?
How the case moves from failure to a verifiable result

items.title: Problem and key mechanism
items.text: A page showing save success early does not prove the database write completed; after checking input and permission, write the target record and wait for commit before returning the actual result.

items.title: How to observe the improvement
items.text: Return success only after the write completes, or return the specific failure instead of relying on early local state. After refresh, query with the same id and show the saved nickname.

items.title: Publishing grades also requires a confirmed write
items.text: After a teacher publishes a grade, the grade record must be written and committed. Reopening the student's grade page and reading the new score confirms the write completed.

modules.title: What this still does not guarantee
modules.text: Writing to a database is not the same as backing up, replicating to every node, or making every read immediately see the value.

distinctions.label: Transaction
distinctions.text: {c:database-write} focuses on single data persistence and commits; a {c:transaction} groups multiple writes into an indivisible commit or rollback boundary.
